records.title: Supply of Fertilizers in Odisha
details: e: In order to increase Indigenous Urea production in the country, Government inter-alia mandate revival of Talchar units of Fertilizer Corporation of India Ltd through Joint Venture Company of nominated PSUs for setting up new Ammonia Urea plant of 12.7 Lakh Metric Tonne Per Annum (LMTPA) capacity. The plant is located at Talchar in Angular district of Odisha. At present, the plant is under construction phase.
